title: Southern Company Utility Account
description: Represents a Southern Company (Alabama Power, Georgia Power, Mississippi Power) utility customer account with associated service address, metering, and billing data.

accountNumber.description: Unique identifier for the utility account.

accountName.description: Name associated with the utility account (customer or business name).

subsidiary.description: The Southern Company subsidiary providing service for this account.

serviceAddress.description: The physical address where utility service is delivered.

meterNumber.description: Unique identifier for the utility meter at the service address.

rateSchedule.description: The regulatory rate tariff code applied to this account (e.g., RS-9, GS-8).

accountStatus.description: Current status of the utility account.

currentBalance.description: Current account balance in US dollars.

dueDate.description: Date by which the current balance is due.
